DETAIL: Replace the combinatorial aggregate SPARQL with SHACL Core conditional branches. Require category evidence; for A/B require the construction date; for dates on or after 2017-01-01 require one tankType. For either regulated tank-type string, require exactly one decimal capacity QuantityValue in unit:M3, then allow capacity <= 30 or require capacity > 30 together with exactly one decimal separation QuantityValue in unit:M having sh:minInclusive 0.76. Do not require capacity for unregulated tank types or separation for capacity <= 30, and preserve the non-applicable Category C and pre-2017 branches.
